limits: No production access or deployment; no zero-defect guarantee.
Physical profile: AMD64 native Rocky8.10/9.8, MySQL8.0.33/8.0.46 in one Docker container, host/independent tool-container execution, GTID OFF/ON, no encryption.
OVPN PKI proof does not certify VPN handshake/OpenSSL3; API proof does not certify Calico dataplane; portability help is startup only.

No target-MySQL-container self-stop/full-restore, automatic failover/traffic control, Galera/GR/multi-source/keyring/external general tablespace/Windows/ARM native/cross-version qualification. Native asynchronous replication is limited to the separately named exact OS/version/GTID profiles.

Offline native restore deliberately compares exact raw startup values from mysqld --verbose --help: explicit absolute data/socket/log-bin/log-bin-index and a direct systemd ExecStart are required; valid relative/default/extension-normalized MySQL configurations may be refused. See operations-manual offline prerequisites; this is not arbitrary my.cnf support.
reuse_boundaries: Historical raw and artifact bytes retain original identities. Current runtime/help revisions use newly executed owning integrations, preserving historical records. Source AST observations do not waive runtime changes. MyBackupCli lifecycle is newly executed; no old lifecycle is relabelled.
Runner branches and original shell/source snapshots are compared under exact scoped compatibility contracts. Common governance prose relocation is separate from executed command/fixture changes.
NetCheck retains the original delivery-owner production acceptance/exemption; its current help/build and AST equivalence are checked without inventing a new business run.
